verdict.rationale: Cognee documents a rich programmatic API (.remember, .recall, .improve, .forget), a CLI, MCP server, and REST API access (Docker-hosted at port 8000), which strongly supports AI-native, documented programmatic access. However, an OpenAPI/Swagger spec probe returned 404s across all candidate paths, meaning the REST API is not documented via a standard machine-readable schema, and there's no independent hands-on confirmation of API robustness. missing for 10: a discoverable OpenAPI/swagger spec, independent/hands-on verification of REST API usage, and clearer REST endpoint reference docs beyond the Docker quick-start.
